prompt: When I open the spectrum analyzer screen on the prop it drops to a crawl and the bars stutter, but the static home screen runs fine. What's going on, and how do I make the spectrum screen smooth?

assertions.text: Identifies per-frame unconditional restyle/realign of all spectrum bars (no shadow-compare) in ui_observer, with file:line
Names the all-PSRAM LVGL allocator as the documented ~8-vs-18 fps cause and points to the hybrid-allocator lever
Recommends change-gating/shadow-compare (mirroring the scanner waveform) and/or cadence throttle for the bars
Findings are board-specific (software render, PSRAM, no GPU) rather than generic LVGL tips
Includes a measurement plan / before-after method using the FPS HUD
